panels.description:
Approvals, change requests and comments given per reviewer (top 20).
datasource: pull_request_comments, pull_requests, project_mapping, accounts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    REPLACE(  
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
      prc.account_id
    ), '-', ' ') AS developer,
  COUNT(DISTINCT prc.pull_request_id) as `Distinct PRs Reviewed`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc.type = 'REVIEW' AND prc.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Change Requests`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc.type = 'REVIEW' AND prc.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Approvals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc.type in ('NORMAL', 'DIFF') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Comments
FROM pull_request_comments prc
JOIN pull_requests pr ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
    AND pr.id like 'github:%'
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND pr.base_repo_id in (
      SELECT pm.row_id
      FROM project_mapping pm
      WHERE pm.table = 'repos'
      AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project}))
    )
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = prc.account_id AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
WHERE prc.commit_sha is not null 
      AND prc.commit_sha <> '' 
      AND $__timeFilter(prc.created_date)
GROUP BY prc.account_id
ORDER BY (`Change Requests` + Approvals + Comments + `Distinct PRs Reviewed`) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Review Activity

panels.description: Each pull request counted once, by its latest review (dismissed reviews ignored).

targets.rawSql:
WITH authored AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.author_id,
         REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''), pr.author_name, NULLIF(TRIM(a.email), ''), '(unmapped)'), '-', ' ') AS Developer
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id AND a.id IN ( $developer_id )
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id like 'github:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN ($repo_id))
    AND pr.base_repo_id in (
      SELECT pm.row_id
      FROM project_mapping pm
      WHERE pm.table = 'repos'
      AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
    )
),
latest AS (
  SELECT prc.pull_request_id, prc.status,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prc.pull_request_id ORDER BY prc.created_date DESC, prc.id DESC) AS rn
  FROM pull_request_comments prc
  JOIN authored au ON au.id = prc.pull_request_id
  WHERE prc.type = 'REVIEW' AND prc.status IN ('APPROVED', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'COMMENTED')
)
SELECT au.Developer,
       SUM(l.status = 'APPROVED')          AS `Approved`,
       SUM(l.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED') AS `Changes requested`,
       SUM(l.status = 'COMMENTED')         AS `Commented`,
       SUM(l.status IS NULL)               AS `No review`
FROM authored au
LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.pull_request_id = au.id AND l.rn = 1
GROUP BY au.Developer
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Review Outcome Mix

panels.description: Lines added and deleted on the selected repositories in the range, excluding merge commits. People are matched to their GitHub account when GitHub links any of their commits.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha, c.additions, c.deletions,
         LOWER(c.author_email)           AS em,
         NULLIF(TRIM(c.author_name), '') AS git_name,
         NULLIF(gc.author_id, 0)         AS gid
  FROM commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc       ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha 
    AND rc.repo_id like 'github:%'
    AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) 
    AND rc.repo_id in (
      select pm.row_id 
      from project_mapping pm 
      where pm.table = 'repos' 
      AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  JOIN accounts a ON a.email = c.author_email
  LEFT JOIN _tool_github_commits gc ON gc.sha = c.sha
  WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM commit_parents cp
      WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha
      GROUP BY cp.commit_sha HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )
),
who AS (SELECT em, COALESCE(MAX(gid), MAX(CASE WHEN em LIKE '%@users.noreply.github.com' AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(em, '+', 1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(em, '+', 1) AS UNSIGNED) END)) AS gid FROM cm GROUP BY em),
gh AS (
  SELECT ga.id, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(ga.name), '')) AS name, MAX(ga.login) AS login
  FROM _tool_github_accounts ga
  WHERE ga.id IN (SELECT gid FROM who WHERE gid IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY ga.id
)
,
acc AS (
  SELECT LOWER(email) AS em, MAX(COALESCE(full_name, user_name)) AS name
  FROM accounts
  WHERE LOWER(email) IN (SELECT em FROM cm)
  GROUP BY LOWER(email)
),
named AS (
  SELECT cm.*,
         REPLACE(COALESCE(gh.name, gh.login, acc.name, cm.git_name, cm.em), '-', ' ') AS person
  FROM cm
  JOIN who ON who.em <=> cm.em
  LEFT JOIN gh ON gh.id = who.gid
  LEFT JOIN acc ON acc.em = cm.em
)
SELECT person AS contributor,
  SUM(additions)      AS 'Lines Added',
  SUM(deletions)     AS 'Lines Removed'
FROM named
GROUP BY person
ORDER BY SUM(additions) + SUM(deletions) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Code Volume

panels.description: Commits on the selected repositories in the range, excluding merge commits. People are matched to their GitHub account when GitHub links any of their commits.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha,
         LOWER(c.author_email)           AS em,
         NULLIF(TRIM(c.author_name), '') AS git_name,
         a.full_name                     AS acc_name,
         NULLIF(gc.author_id, 0)         AS gid
  FROM commits c
JOIN repo_commits rc      ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha 
    AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id})) 
    AND rc.repo_id in (
        select pm.row_id 
        from project_mapping pm 
        where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project}))
        )
JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = c.author_email
LEFT JOIN _tool_github_commits gc ON gc.sha = c.sha
  WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha) < 2
),
who AS (SELECT em, COALESCE(MAX(gid), MAX(CASE WHEN em LIKE '%@users.noreply.github.com' AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(em, '+', 1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(em, '+', 1) AS UNSIGNED) END)) AS gid FROM cm GROUP BY em),
gh AS (
  SELECT ga.id, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(ga.name), '')) AS name, MAX(ga.login) AS login
  FROM _tool_github_accounts ga
  WHERE ga.id IN (SELECT gid FROM who WHERE gid IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY ga.id
),
named AS (
  SELECT cm.*,
         REPLACE(COALESCE(gh.name, gh.login, cm.acc_name, cm.git_name, cm.em), '-', ' ') AS person
  FROM cm
  JOIN who ON who.em <=> cm.em
  LEFT JOIN gh ON gh.id = who.gid
)
SELECT person AS contributor,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sha) AS commits
FROM named
GROUP BY person
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sha) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Contributions By Commits

panels.description: Commits on pull requests, by the pull request's outcome.

targets.rawSql:
-- Counts each PR commit once per author, marking it Landed if any of its PRs merged and Abandoned if the PR closed unmerged, top 20 developers.
WITH _commit_logs AS (
    SELECT prc.commit_sha,
           MAX(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'MERGED'
                     AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
                     AND pr.base_repo_id IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS landed,
           MAX(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'CLOSED'
                     AND pr.merged_date IS NULL
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_unmerged,
           c.author_id as author_id,
           c.author_email as author_email,
           c.author_name as author_name
    FROM pull_request_commits prc
    JOIN pull_requests pr
      ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id
      AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    JOIN project_mapping pm 
      ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
      AND pm.table = 'repos'
      AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project}))
    JOIN commits c ON c.sha = prc.commit_sha
    WHERE prc.pull_request_id like 'github:%' 
      AND $__timeFilter(prc.commit_authored_date)
    GROUP BY prc.commit_sha, c.author_id, c.author_email, c.author_name
),
cm AS (
  SELECT cl.commit_sha AS sha, cl.landed, cl.closed_unmerged,
         LOWER(cl.author_email)              AS em,
         NULLIF(TRIM(cl.author_name), '')    AS git_name,
         COALESCE(a.full_name, a.user_name)  AS acc_name,
         NULLIF(gc.author_id, 0)             AS gid
  FROM _commit_logs cl
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = cl.author_id
  LEFT JOIN _tool_github_commits gc ON gc.sha = cl.commit_sha
),
who AS (SELECT em, COALESCE(MAX(gid), MAX(CASE WHEN em LIKE '%@users.noreply.github.com' AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(em, '+', 1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(em, '+', 1) AS UNSIGNED) END)) AS gid FROM cm GROUP BY em),
gh AS (
  SELECT ga.id, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(ga.name), '')) AS name, MAX(ga.login) AS login
  FROM _tool_github_accounts ga
  WHERE ga.id IN (SELECT gid FROM who WHERE gid IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY ga.id
),
named AS (
  SELECT cm.*,
         REPLACE(COALESCE(gh.name, gh.login, cm.acc_name, cm.git_name, '(unmapped)'), '-', ' ') AS person
  FROM cm
  JOIN who ON who.em <=> cm.em
  LEFT JOIN gh ON gh.id = who.gid
)
SELECT person AS developer,
       SUM(landed) AS Landed,
       SUM(closed_unmerged) AS Abandoned
FROM named
GROUP BY person
ORDER BY SUM(closed_unmerged) + SUM(landed) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Commits Outcome (PR commits)

panels.description:
Per-developer scorecard of commits, PR contributions, reviews given and PRs authored.
datasource: pull_requests, project_mapping, commits, repo_commits, commit_parents, accounts, pull_request_commits, pull_request_comments

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped_prs AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.author_id, pr.status, pr.created_date
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (
      SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm
      WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos'
        AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
),

code_volume AS (
  SELECT c.author_email        AS email,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.sha) AS commits,
         SUM(c.additions)      AS lines_added,
         SUM(c.deletions)      AS lines_deleted
  FROM commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
   AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
   AND rc.repo_id IN (
     SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm
     WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos'
       AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM commit_parents cp
      WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha
      GROUP BY cp.commit_sha HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM accounts a
      where a.id = c.author_email
    )
  GROUP BY c.author_email
),

contributed AS (
  -- pull_request_commits carries the author email directly, so no join back to commits
  SELECT prc.commit_author_email AS email,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.status = 'MERGED' THEN pr.id END) AS prs_merged_contributed,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.status = 'CLOSED' THEN pr.id END) AS prs_abandoned_contributed
  FROM scoped_prs pr
  JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM accounts a
    WHERE a.email = prc.commit_author_email
  )
  GROUP BY prc.commit_author_email
),

reviewed AS (
  SELECT a.email,
         SUM(cmt.type = 'REVIEW' AND cmt.status = 'APPROVED')          AS approvals_given,
         SUM(cmt.type = 'REVIEW' AND cmt.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED') AS change_requests_given,
         SUM(cmt.type IN ('NORMAL','DIFF'))                            AS comments_given,
         COUNT(DISTINCT cmt.pull_request_id)                           AS prs_reviewed
  FROM pull_request_comments cmt
  JOIN scoped_prs pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
                    AND cmt.account_id <> pr.author_id
  JOIN accounts a    ON a.id = cmt.account_id
                    AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
  WHERE $__timeFilter(cmt.created_date)
  GROUP BY a.email
),

authored AS (
  SELECT a.email,
         COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id)                                         AS prs_opened,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.status = 'MERGED' THEN pr.id END) AS prs_merged,
         COUNT(cmt.id)                                                 AS change_requests_received
  FROM scoped_prs pr
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
                 AND a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
  LEFT JOIN pull_request_comments cmt
         ON cmt.pull_request_id = pr.id
        AND cmt.type       = 'REVIEW'
        AND cmt.status     = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'
        AND cmt.account_id <> pr.author_id
  GROUP BY a.email
),

spine AS (
  SELECT email FROM code_volume
  UNION SELECT email FROM contributed
  UNION SELECT email FROM authored
  UNION SELECT email FROM reviewed
),

dev AS (
  -- one account per email; accounts.email is not unique, so collapse before resolving names
  SELECT a.email, MIN(a.id) AS account_id
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.id IN ( ${developer_id} )
  GROUP BY a.email
)

SELECT REPLACE(COALESCE(
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name),    ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name),    ''),
         NULLIF(TRIM(s.email),        ''),
         '(unmapped)'
       ), '-', ' ')                                  AS `Developer`,

       COALESCE(cv.commits,       0)                 AS `Commits`,
       COALESCE(cv.lines_added,   0)                 AS `Lines Added`,
       COALESCE(cv.lines_deleted, 0)                 AS `Lines Deleted`,
       COALESCE(co.prs_merged_contributed,    0)     AS `Commits Landed`,
       COALESCE(co.prs_abandoned_contributed, 0)     AS `Commits Abandoned`,

       COALESCE(au.prs_opened,               0)      AS `PRs Opened`,
       COALESCE(au.prs_merged,               0)      AS `PRs Merged`,
       COALESCE(au.change_requests_received, 0)      AS `Change Requests Received`,

       COALESCE(rv.prs_reviewed,          0)         AS `PRs Reviewed`,
       COALESCE(rv.approvals_given,       0)         AS `Approvals Given`,
       COALESCE(rv.change_requests_given, 0)         AS `Change Requests Given`,
       COALESCE(rv.comments_given,        0)         AS `Comments Given`

FROM spine s
LEFT JOIN dev          d  ON d.email = s.email
LEFT JOIN accounts     a  ON a.id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN code_volume  cv ON cv.email = s.email
LEFT JOIN contributed  co ON co.email = s.email
LEFT JOIN authored     au ON au.email = s.email
LEFT JOIN reviewed     rv ON rv.email = s.email
ORDER BY `Developer`;

list.definition:
select DISTINCT upm.project_name
from user_project_mapping upm 
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'github:%'
and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}

list.query:
SELECT p.project_name AS __text, p.project_name AS __value FROM (
select DISTINCT upm.project_name
from user_project_mapping upm 
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'github:%'
and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
) p
UNION ALL
SELECT '(no projects with GitHub data)' AS __text, '__none__' AS __value FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (
select DISTINCT upm.project_name
from user_project_mapping upm 
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.row_id like 'github:%'
and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
)
ORDER BY __text

list.definition:
WITH scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT r.id
  FROM repos r
  WHERE r.id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND r.deleted = 0
    AND r.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  -- PR authors
  SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'github:%'
  UNION
  -- reviewers and commenters
  SELECT cmt.account_id
  FROM pull_request_comments cmt
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
  JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'github:%'
  UNION
  -- issue assignees, scoped through boards (github board ids match repo ids)
  SELECT ia.assignee_id
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND bi.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
)
SELECT CONCAT(
         REPLACE(COALESCE(
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
           '(unmapped)'
         ), '-', ' '),
         '--', a.id) AS Name
FROM accounts a
JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY Name
ORDER BY Name

  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND bi.board_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
)
SELECT CONCAT(
         REPLACE(COALESCE(
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
           '(unmapped)'
         ), '-', ' '),
         '--', a.id) AS Name
FROM accounts a
JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY Name
ORDER BY Name
